descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后画的酥皮与肉汁，盘边留着一个转向箭头。
descriptions.en: A turn arrow sits beside the messenger’s after-meal pastry-and-gravy sketch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自绘的香草冰淇淋里，脆糖块旁多了小小的响声线。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s vanilla ice cream sketch gives its crunchy honeycomb tiny sound lines.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸相机翻开后，笑脸终于站到另一边。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s paper camera opens to put a smile on the other side.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的小纸椅旁边，坐着一个肩膀放松的小身影。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s folded paper seat holds a little figure with relaxed shoulders.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使裁下的纸脚印把抢出去的半步收了回来。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s cut paper footprint brings an impatient half step back into line.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的原创拉片让纸眼睛睁开，笑脸留着一点歪。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s original pull card opens paper eyes above a deliberately uneven grin.
